source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 21
statement: The CoSec-* request parameters are strict: both versions read them alike, and one stated twice in disagreement is refused (400) by both.
guards: compat:EdgeCompatTest#the CoSec parameters are read alike, and an ambiguous one refused, by both versions
